summary: zlib-style inflate state machine. Rejects a NULL handle and returns -2. Walks a per-state machine over the block pointed to by a1[7], dispatched by a jump table at 0x00535BCC. State 0 validates the compression header (method must be 8, window size bound); state 1 reads and checks the header checksum (modulo 0x1F); states 2-5 accumulate a 4-byte big-endian dictionary-size field, then state 6 requires a dictionary (return -2). State 7 drives the inflate core sub_537110 and on stream end resets sub-state via StateResetWithCallback (0x00537000). States 8-11 accumulate a 4-byte trailer that must equal the computed checksum to reach state 12 (return 1); state 13 returns -3. Errors arm one of five message strings at a1[6].

local_names.a1: inflate stream handle: [0]=input cursor, [1]=bytes remaining, [2]=byte counter, [6]=error message pointer, [7]=state block, [12]=dictionary size out
local_names.a2: flush mode; only the value 4 selects the 0xFFFFFFFB intermediate-return variant

operations.description: Reject invalid stream handle: returns -2 when a1, a1[7] (state block), or *a1 (input cursor) is NULL
Initialize the return accumulator v3 to -5; when flush mode a2 equals 4 select 0xFFFFFFFB as the intermediate return value, otherwise 0
Infinite loop dispatching on the state field *(_DWORD*)a1[7]; the switch is driven through the jump table at jpt_53582B (0x00535BCC)
Intermediate-input guard: every byte-reading state returns the accumulated value when a1[1] (bytes remaining) reaches zero
State 0 (header): consume one input byte, decrement a1[1], increment a1[2], and store the read byte into state+4
State 0 validation: when (state+4 & 0xF) != 8 the compression method is not deflate; set state 13, arm the 'unknown compression method' string aUnknownCompres_1 at a1[6], and set state+4 to 5

State 0 validation: when ((state+4 >> 4) + 8) > state+16 the window size exceeds the available buffer; set state 13, arm the 'invalid window size' string aInvalidWindowS_0 at a1[6], and set state+4 to 5
State 0 success: advance to state 1, which reads the header checksum byte

State 1: consume a byte and fold it with (state+4 << 8); the combined value modulo 0x1F must be zero (header checksum check), otherwise set state 13, arm the 'incorrect header check' string aIncorrectHeade_0 at a1[6], and set state+4 to 5
State 1: when (byte & 0x20) is clear the FDICT flag is absent -> state 7 (decompression); otherwise state 2 (read the dictionary size)
States 2-5: accumulate the 4-byte big-endian dictionary-size field into state+8 across four byte reads, advancing the state number after each byte
State 5 completion: publish the accumulated state+8 into a1[12], advance to state 6, and return 2 (dictionary required)
State 6: set state 13, arm the 'need dictionary' string aNeedDictionary_0 at a1[6], zero state+4, and return -2
State 7: invoke the inflate core sub_537110 (0x00537110) on the current block; when it returns -3 set state 13 and clear state+4

State 7 success path: after the core reports stream end, call StateResetWithCallback (0x00537000) on a1[7]+4 to reset the sub-block state; then move to state 12 when state+12 is set, otherwise state 8
States 8-11: accumulate the 4-byte big-endian stream trailer (checksum) into state+8, advancing the state number after each byte

State 11 completion: when state+4 (computed checksum) equals state+8 (read checksum) set state 12 and return 1; otherwise set state 13, arm the 'incorrect data check' string aIncorrectDataC_0 at a1[6], and set state+4 to 5
State 12 returns 1 (stream end); state 13 returns -3; any other state returns -2
Stream decoder entry called from BufferedFileReader (0x00534F90) and sub_59B260 (0x0059B260); returns the inflate status code selected by the current state

clean_pseudocode: case 0: read header byte; validate method==8 and window size;
case 1: read checksum byte; ((byte<<8)+state4) % 0x1F must be 0; FDICT? state 2 : state 7;
case 2..5: accumulate 4-byte dictionary size into state+8; at end a1[12]=state+8; state=6; return 2;
case 6: arm "need dictionary"; state=13; state+4=0; return -2;
case 7: r = sub_537110(ret); if stream end { StateResetWithCallback(a1[7]+4); state = *(a1[7]+12) ? 12 : 8; }
case 8..11: accumulate 4-byte trailer into state+8; at end compare to state+4 -> state 12 return 1, else error;
